verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is an API-first engine. Its docs say all search modes are exposed 'from a single API', describe dedicated endpoints authenticated by API keys, and list typed SDKs for ten languages plus a native MCP route at POST /mcp. Community users report driving indexing and settings programmatically. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at common paths), and a detailed endpoint-by-endpoint API reference in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API
Facet search is a dedicated endpoint for searching through the values of a single facet.
API keys authenticate requests, while tenant tokens restrict what data each user can see within a shared index.
Integrate powerful search into your mobile and web applications with our easy-to-use APIs and SDKs for every major language.
Meilisearch ships a native MCP server at the POST /mcp route so any MCP-compatible client can search your indexes directly.
